title: A System-of-Systems Case Study for the Verification of Composed Digital Twins
abstract: arXiv:2608.28498v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Current approaches to engineering dependable Digital Twins (DTs) of Cyber-Physical Systems lack practical guidance on how qualities such as relevance, verifiability, substitutability and fidelity may be formalised and verified. This need is amplified in Systems-of-Systems (SoS), where reliance is placed on the composition of DTs. The goal of this study is to identify foundational challenges that a framework for DT validation and verification should address in an SoS setting, and to investigate the formalisation of individual DT artefacts as a step towards compositional reasoning. We present a case study based on a DT-enabled greenhouse SoS modelled in VDM-RT (Vienna Development Method, Real-Time), including executable formal models, a property-based account of DT qualities, and an analysis of the obstacles arising when attempting to compose these artefacts at the SoS level. translated_title: 用于验证组合式数字孪生的系统之系统案例研究
translated_abstract: 当前构建可信的网络物理系统数字孪生的方法，在如何将相关性、可验证性、可替代性和保真度等质量属性形式化并加以验证方面缺乏实践指导。这一需求在系统之系统环境中被进一步放大，因为系统之系统依赖于多个数字孪生的组合。本研究的目标是识别数字孪生验证与确认框架在系统之系统环境中应解决的基础性挑战，并研究如何将单个数字孪生工件形式化，作为迈向组合推理的一步。我们提出了一个基于VDM-RT（维也纳开发方法-实时扩展）建模的数字孪生赋能温室系统之系统的案例研究，包括可执行的形式化模型、对数字孪生质量属性的基于属性的刻画，以及对在系统之系统层面尝试组合这些工件时所出现障碍的分析。我们探讨了如何将数字孪生质量属性操作化为一组可验证的性质。
tldr: 本文通过一个基于VDM-RT形式化建模的温室系统之系统案例研究，识别了在系统之系统环境中验证组合式数字孪生所面临的基础性挑战，并探索了将相关性、可验证性、可替代性和保真度等数字孪生质量属性形式化以支持组合推理的途径。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a VDM-RT-based greenhouse System-of-Systems case study that identifies foundational challenges for verifying composed Digital Twins and explores formalizing DT qualities such as relevance, verifiability, substitutability, and fidelity as a step toward compositional reasoning.
